name: Yonaguni Yona
source:
A cocky tsundere mesugaki young lady. Mysterious and dressed in gothic lolita, with a bandage ribbon wrapped around her head. She enjoys teasing the protagonist whenever she spots him peeking into the hotel rooms, and is the wife of the owner of the hotel where he works. She refers to herself as Yona-tama.

[Translated from [url=https://enoshima210.work/2022/11/11/yona/]official site[/url]]
